title: Feeling rich is how people get poor
hook: Feeling rich is one of the fastest ways to get poor.
caption: Feeling rich is how people get poor. Paper gains make us spend real cash and take real debt; when prices fall the gains vanish but the payments stay. Spend what you've banked, never what's on the screen.

headline: FEELING RICH
MAKES YOU
POOR.

scenes.say: Feeling rich is one of the fastest ways to get poor.
Your stocks are green. Your house price went up. You feel wealthy.
So you spend real cash, and borrow real debt, against paper gains.
Then prices fall. The gains vanish. The payments don't.
That's why so many people feel poorer exactly when the market turns.
Spend what you've banked. Never what's still on the screen.

takeaway: Spend what you've banked. Never what's still on the screen.
